_note: Final thesis item F4.1 - system definition and sizing of all load stations and conveyors. Values = DESIGN values or REFERENCE ESTIMATES. Inputs from F2 (fms_design.py: flows, machines, layout rows) and F3 (asrs_design.py: crane cycle, moves, line-side buffers). Tool: conv_system.py. Guide: Doctor paper/61_final_conveyors_load_stations.md.
_peak_note: same peak factor as F3 (crane moves): busiest hour = 1.6 x average hour
_overflow_note: design rule: probability that a lane is full when a crate must be put on it <= 1 %

crate._orient: travels with the 800 side leading on all crate conveyors (fork entry on the 800 side, F3)

conveyor._note: chain zone 1.2 m = crate 800 + 400 gap (800 leading, runners cross the chains); roller zone 1.4 m = crate 1200 + 200 (1200 leading, runners cross the rollers - F4.2 ch. 12); transfer unit (TU) = chain part x + lifted roller part y

asrs_front._note: U-loop in front of the aisle (x < 0 away from the rack, y across the aisle; crate centre y = +-1.4 m = F3 fork pick point). CV1 infeed side L (y = -1.4), CV2 outfeed side R (y = +1.4), CV3 cross conveyor with the pick / rework position between the two transfer units. AGVs dock sideways at TU1 / TU2 from the outer sides (y = -/+ 2.6 m), the operator stands at x = -7.0 between them, separated by fences. Check station = TU1 (deadlock-free rule set R0-R4, see conv_system.Front).
CV1: AGV drop-off (sideways) + merge from CV3; WEIGHING transfer (4 load cells) with contour light frame and ID reader: every crate is checked here (AGV waits for the result; a fail goes back onto the AGV)
P&D in: crane fork picks here
CV2: P&D out: crane fork puts here
second AGV pick-up place (sideways); crates pass through when no AGV is there
AGV pick-up (sideways) or divert to CV3 (kit visit)
CV3: pick / rework position (crate 1200 leading, operator at x = -7.0)
asrs_front._agv_note: time from AGV dispatch (= crane starts the retrieval) until the AGV stands at the pick-up transfer, exponential; F5 must confirm
asrs_front._pickup_note: CV2 index of the AGV pick-up transfers: 5 = TU2 (end), 3 = TU3 at x = -3.6 (second pick-up place, decided by the DES: one place saturates)

_agv_resp_note: outbound lane: the crate waits for an AGV for at most this time in the design case (F5 dispatch target p95)
_inbound_note: inbound lane: time until the operator pulls the crate to the machine (one crate in use per running part)

no_conveyor_depts.TOOL: tool trolleys (AGV with trolley pick-up, floor station)
no_conveyor_depts.SHP: fed by the assembly line conveyor; trucks by forklift

_first_op_note: department of the first operation (products.json ops[0].machine -> fms_data machines.dept); line-side buffer crates stand on the inbound lane of that department

assembly._note: products travel singly on workpiece carriers (skids) through assembly -> test -> paint -> pack -> shipping; parallel stations on spurs (lift-transfer in / out), main loop with empty-carrier return

carrier._unit: VC20 on 300 L tank ~1550 x 550 x 1100 mm, ~120 kg (design estimate); RB on base frame ~900 x 600, <= 180 kg

cost_EUR._note: REFERENCE ESTIMATES (installed, incl. drives and local controls hardware, without PLC software and safety system F8)

_non_crate_note: 300 L tanks (~1550 mm) and motors do not fit the 1200 x 800 crate: BUY -> ASY is a separate tank/motor feed to the assembly load station (designed in F4.4: tank racks on a tugger / AGV with rack top)
